core_types.name: TracerProvider
core_types.description: Factory and lifecycle owner of Tracer instances

core_types.name: Span
core_types.description: Active tracing span recording attributes, events, and status

core_types.name: BatchSpanProcessor
core_types.description: Buffered worker goroutine batching spans for export

concurrency_model.synchronization: Channel or bounded ring buffer queue for spans; atomic flags for Span state

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: Context embeds SpanContext and propagates TraceParent/TraceState across process boundaries
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: TracerProvider.Shutdown(ctx) drains pending queue and waits for export completion

retry_model.strategy: OTLP exporter retry with exponential backoff on transient network failure

boundaries.network: OTLP gRPC or HTTP transport to OpenTelemetry Collector
boundaries.os: Clock syscalls (runtime/nanotime) for precise span timestamping
boundaries.serialization: W3C Trace Context headers and OTLP Protobuf payloads
